summary.answer: Takes menu f1_arg0, controller f1_arg1 and eight layout bounds f1_arg2..f1_arg9; calls LUI.UIElement.new and sets the literal class/id/sound. Creates six decorative image children in order, including the tinted base, gradient, pixel backing, center fractal and two grid-line overlays. The pixel/grid images use the literal nine-slice sizes and shader values in the trace; no feed insertion, hacking state update or event callback is implemented in this body. Exact child order: BG, BgGrad, PixelGridTiledBacking, CenterFractal02, GridLine, GridLineAdd. All layout/property/asset values and each callback body are retained in the ordered trace. Calls the optional same-file-or-unresolved PostLoadFunc at its exact source position, then returns self; a same name in another file supplies no binding.
